description: Manufacturing processes decomposed. Machining variants (turning, milling, drilling, grinding, EDM), additive (FDM, SLA, SLS, DMLS, MJF), forming (forging, stamping, sheet metal), joining (welding variants, brazing, adhesives), GD&T datum reference frames + material conditions.

sub_mechanisms.name: CNC_turning_lathe
sub_mechanisms.definition: Rotating workpiece; single-point cutting tool. Z (axial) + X (radial) axes. Live tooling adds Y.
sub_mechanisms.why: Cylindrical parts. Shafts, bushings, fittings. Modern CNC: complex profiles, threading, parting. Standard process.

sub_mechanisms.name: CNC_milling_axes
sub_mechanisms.definition: 3-axis: linear X/Y/Z. 5-axis: + rotational A/B. Continuous 5-axis for complex surfaces.
sub_mechanisms.why: Complex 3D. Aerospace parts, mold tooling. 5-axis enables single setup for complex geometries. Industry standard.

sub_mechanisms.name: grinding_precision
sub_mechanisms.definition: Abrasive wheel removes material. μm precision. Cylindrical, surface, centerless.
sub_mechanisms.why: Tight tolerance + smooth finish. Bearing races, gauges, dies. Slower than turning/milling; precision unmatched.

sub_mechanisms.name: EDM_electrical_discharge
sub_mechanisms.definition: Spark erodes material. Wire EDM cuts, sinker EDM forms cavities.
sub_mechanisms.why: Hard materials, complex shapes. Die-making, aerospace. No cutting forces — fine features possible. Slow but precise.

sub_mechanisms.name: FDM_filament
sub_mechanisms.definition: Fused Deposition Modeling. Heated nozzle extrudes thermoplastic filament.
sub_mechanisms.why: Most common additive. Cheap, accessible. PLA, ABS, PETG, nylon, TPU. Hobby + functional prototypes.

sub_mechanisms.name: SLA_DLP_resin
sub_mechanisms.definition: Stereolithography. UV-cured liquid resin. Layer-by-layer. Very fine resolution.
sub_mechanisms.why: High detail. Dental, jewelry, miniatures. Photopolymer chemistry. Brittle vs FDM.

sub_mechanisms.name: SLS_powder
sub_mechanisms.definition: Selective Laser Sintering. Laser fuses nylon powder.
sub_mechanisms.why: Functional plastic parts. No supports needed (powder bed). Stronger than FDM. Industrial process.

sub_mechanisms.name: DMLS_metal_AM
sub_mechanisms.definition: Direct Metal Laser Sintering. Laser melts metal powder.
sub_mechanisms.why: Production metal parts. Titanium, Inconel, aluminum. Aerospace + medical. Topology-optimised brackets, jet nozzles.

sub_mechanisms.name: forging_hot_cold
sub_mechanisms.definition: Hot: above recrystallisation, less force, complex shapes. Cold: stronger, tight tolerances.
sub_mechanisms.why: Critical parts (crankshafts, connecting rods, blades). Grain flow follows shape → strength. Standard for high-stress.

sub_mechanisms.name: sheet_metal_forming
sub_mechanisms.definition: Bending, drawing, stamping, hydroforming. From flat sheet to 3D shape.
sub_mechanisms.why: Automotive bodies, appliances, enclosures. Stamping high-volume; press brake low-volume. Foundation of mass production.

sub_mechanisms.name: welding_processes_variants
sub_mechanisms.definition: SMAW (stick), GMAW (MIG), GTAW (TIG), FCAW (flux core), SAW (submerged arc), laser, friction stir.
sub_mechanisms.why: Different materials, joint types, productivity. MIG: high deposition; TIG: thin/precise; FSW: aluminium without melting.

sub_mechanisms.name: GDT_datum_reference_frame
sub_mechanisms.definition: Primary, secondary, tertiary datums. Establish coordinate system for measurement.
sub_mechanisms.why: Consistent inspection. Datum features physically constrain part. Without DRF, GD&T tolerances meaningless. ASME Y14.5.

derivation_rules.name: 5_axis_eliminates_setups
if: part has complex geometry on multiple faces
derivation_rules.why: 3-axis: re-fixture for each face = stack-up tolerance error. 5-axis: one setup. Reduces error. Higher capital cost; lower per-part cost.

derivation_rules.name: DFM_design_for_manufacturing
then: cost increases substantially or part is unmanufacturable
derivation_rules.why: DFM: minimum draft, uniform wall, accessible features. Without: expensive workarounds. Standard collaboration: design + manufacturing engineering.

derivation_rules.name: additive_enables_internal_features
then: additive manufacturing enables what subtractive can't
derivation_rules.why: Internal lattices, cooling channels, organic shapes. SpaceX, GE LEAP nozzle, medical implants. Topology optimisation maximises.

derivation_rules.name: forging_grain_flow_strength
then: grain follows part shape → higher fatigue strength
derivation_rules.why: Random grain in cast = weak. Aligned grain in forged = strong along grain. Crankshafts always forged, never cast. Standard for high-stress.

derivation_rules.name: GDT_DRF_required_for_meaningful_inspection
then: datum reference frame establishes measurement context
derivation_rules.why: Without DRF: 'within 0.1 mm of where?'. With DRF: precise reference. Standard practice. ASME Y14.5 enforces datum hierarchy.
